falseSynonyms.zh: 意圖不等於注意 intention 表示打算做甚麼；attention 表示注意、專注或關注。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Her intention was to leave early. Her attention was on the presentation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 吸引力不等於注意力 attraction 是吸引人的力量或事物；attention 是被吸引後所給予的注意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The bright display was an attraction. It quickly caught everyone's attention.

falseSynonyms.zh: 分心不等於注意 distraction 是把注意力移走的東西，和集中注意相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The noise was a distraction. I could not keep my attention on the book.

falseSynonyms.zh: 好奇不等於注意 curiosity 表示想知道更多；它可以引起注意，但不等於注意本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Curiosity made her ask questions. The strange sound caught her attention.

falseSynonyms.zh: 記憶不等於注意 memory 表示記住事情的能力或內容；attention 是當下的注意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Good attention can help learning, but memory is the ability to retain information.

falseSynonyms.zh: 盯著看不等於注意 stare 是長時間直視；一個人可以注意某事而不需要盯著看。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He stared at the screen. He paid attention to the explanation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與名詞不同 attentive 是形容詞，表示專心的；attention 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The students were attentive. The teacher had their attention.

falseSynonyms.zh: 留意不等於通知 notice 可表示注意或公告；notification 是通知訊息，不等於人的注意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The error escaped my notice. The app sent me a notification.
